description: Source code implementing reference cache management and iteration for a Git-like repository system, including functions for creating, freeing, sorting, and searching reference entries and directories, as well as iterators for traversing references with prefix filtering.

classes.name: ref_dir
classes.description: Represents a directory of references, containing entries and metadata for sorting and duplicate removal.

classes.name: ref_entry
classes.description: Represents a single reference entry, which can be a direct reference or a subdirectory.

classes.name: string_slice
classes.description: Helper structure for string comparison during search operations.

classes.name: cache_ref_iterator_level
classes.description: Represents a level in the recursive reference iterator stack.

classes.name: cache_ref_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing references in the cache, supporting prefix filtering and recursive descent.

methods.name: add_entry_to_dir
methods.description: Adds a reference entry to a directory, maintaining sorted order if applicable.

methods.name: get_ref_dir
methods.description: Retrieves the directory associated with a reference entry, filling it if incomplete.

methods.name: create_ref_entry
methods.description: Creates a new reference entry with specified name, referent, object ID, and flags.

methods.name: create_ref_cache
methods.description: Creates a new reference cache associated with a reference store and fill function.

methods.name: free_ref_entry
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a reference entry, including subdirectory if applicable.

methods.name: free_ref_cache
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a reference cache.

methods.name: clear_ref_dir
methods.description: Recursively clears all entries in a reference directory.

methods.name: create_dir_entry
methods.description: Creates a directory reference entry, marked as incomplete.

methods.name: ref_entry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for reference entries based on name.

methods.name: sort_ref_dir
methods.description: Sorts directory entries and removes duplicates.

methods.name: overlaps_prefix
methods.description: Determines the prefix relationship between a directory name and a prefix string.

methods.name: prime_ref_dir
methods.description: Recursively loads references from a directory that may match a given prefix.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the reference iterator to the next reference, descending into subdirectories as needed.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_set_prefix
methods.description: Sets a prefix filter for the reference iterator, priming relevant directories.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific reference name or prefix within the cache.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the reference iterator.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes a new reference iterator with optional prefix filtering.
